name: Salesflare
tagline: Salesflare is an intelligent CRM built for small B2B businesses that automatically logs emails, meetings, and calls to keep contact records up to date. Its AI surfaces follow-up reminders and opportunities, reducing the manual data entry burden that makes many CRMs hard to maintain.
